# WhereDaBusStay

> Real-time TheBus arrivals and stop info for Oahu, Hawaiʻi. Find nearby bus stops on a map, see live arrival times, track buses, save favorite stops, and read rider announcements and service alerts.

WhereDaBusStay is a free, installable web app for riders of TheBus, Oahu's public bus system. Arrival times come from TheBus real-time data; stop and route information comes from TheBus GTFS schedule data.

## App

- [WhereDaBusStay](https://wheredabusstay.com/): Nearby stops map, stop search, live arrivals, routes, favorites, news and settings

## Data sources

- [TheBus](https://www.thebus.org/): Oahu's public bus system, operator of the routes and stops shown
